info.title: Production Order (Version 2)
info.description: Besides updating header data of the order including the scheduling type, you can also update and delete order components. You can update some properties of the order operations. This service enables you to convert planned orders to production orders, schedule production order operations, and set further statuses for the order such as technically completed, closed, discarded by MES, or released by MES. In addition, you can set the deletion flag, deletion indicator, and delivery completed indicator.

x-sap-shortText: In addition to create, read, and update production orders, you can also release orders and operations

x-sap-extensible.description:
If you are working with key user extensibility, the API can be extended by custom fields on the following business contexts (field usage for this API needs to be selected):
* Order Master Data (FINS_ORDER)
* Manufacturing: Order Operation (PP_ORDER_OPERATION)
* Reservation Document Item (RESERVATIONDOCUMENTITEM)

[How to add an extension field to an API](https://help.sap.com/docs/ABAP_PLATFORM_NEW/b5670aaaa2364a29935f40b16499972d/ce819b8557194ae0aa180ba4ac6a04de.html)

Note: Please make sure to match the release selected in SAP Business Accelerator Hub with the Feature Pack (FPS) on help page.
